title: What Is a Stop-Loss? Protect Your Crypto Trades (Beginner Guide)
caption: A stop-loss is an automatic exit order that limits how much one trade can cost you. Here is how it works, and its limits.

scenes.head: WHAT IS A STOP-LOSS?
scenes.narration: Prices can fall fast. A stop-loss is a simple tool traders use to limit how much one trade can cost them.

scenes.head: AN AUTOMATIC EXIT
scenes.narration: You choose a price in advance. If the market falls to that price, your order sells automatically, with no panic.

scenes.head: A SIMPLE EXAMPLE
scenes.narration: Say you set your exit ten percent below your entry. A deeper drop is then cut short, and your loss stays limited.

scenes.head: WHY IT HELPS
scenes.narration: Fear and greed push people into bad choices. A plan made calmly beforehand helps remove emotion from the moment.

scenes.head: IT IS NOT PERFECT
scenes.narration: It has limits. In fast markets the sale can happen below your price, and a quick dip can trigger it before a rebound.

scenes.head: BEFORE YOU TRADE
scenes.narration: Know how much you can afford to lose, avoid borrowed money, and learn the tools before using real funds.
